Pollux alone is super strong early because of his high scaling on his first attack, with that he pairs well with Horla because she applies buffs (mainly her snarl psalm for final damage) her exalt adds crit

From there for a newer player, I'd say Caecus and Sanga, they pair well to help feel a lot safer

Are Aurita and or Pontus good to go beyond level 60 with? Or are they better to save for a lot later on that?

They generally share the same slot in a discard team, pontos is more of a support tank until e3 when you can reliably spam and grab gaunts out, and his OE isn't bad

Similarly, Aurita needs some setup to hit some big exalts and jellyspam

Pontos better for flexibility cause you can run him for -str on a counter comp with caecus, or more discard fuel and sub-dps, or good at peeling off corrosion with gaunt spam + pack hunt
Either will function though, and Aurita is much easier to build
So are they good to go beyond level 60 with or should I likely wait to do that later?
Since I know even some really good characters aren’t really good to level due to leveling up not doing much for them, that’s why I wanted to ask

Aurita has lower stats, but will use them more than Pontos, so if you're wanting to put levels into one of them you'll get more out of pontos on your team, and aurita will get more out of levels

There aren't really "bad" characters to level, stats are stats, if you use the character they will use the levels, vortice is kind of the meme with that where her exalt is purely tentacle damage so her stats don't scale her damage in the same way, but con will still scale

In that sense, aurita > pontos <:tohshrug:1120471804885086309>  but the difference is minimal

If I put 10 levels into my pontos, I get 20/15/20

10 levels into my aurita I get 12/12/12

Pontos won't care about the attack for exalt or gaunts, and minimally for gaunt ravage, while he'll add more tanky stats to the team <:tohshrug:1120471804885086309> 

So you lose 8 con/def giving levels to aurita > pontos, but you make better use of the attack
